ios.desc:
Looking for a more flexible way to enjoy YouTube? Want to keep videos playing in the background, use Picture-in-Picture while multitasking, or simply enjoy a smoother viewing experience? Tube PiP makes watching and listening easier and more convenient.

Tube PiP is a feature-rich player designed for YouTube users, offering practical tools to enhance your everyday viewing experience.

=Feature Highlights=

* Picture-in-Picture: Keep watching videos while chatting, shopping, browsing the web, or using other apps. Multitasking has never been easier!
* Background Playback: Keep listening to music, lectures, podcasts, talk shows, and more while using other apps.
* Lock Screen Playback: Continue listening even when your screen is locked—perfect for music, podcasts, and long-form content.
* Fewer Interruptions: Enjoy a cleaner, more focused viewing experience with fewer distractions.
* Sleep Timer: Set a timer to automatically stop playback when watching videos or listening to music before bed.
* Smooth & Familiar Experience: A clean, intuitive interface makes Tube PiP simple and easy to use.

=Why Choose Tube PiP?=

* Get started for free and enjoy a range of useful features.
* Simple, clean, and easy-to-use interface.
* Enjoy Picture-in-Picture, background playback, lock screen playback, and more.
* A flexible viewing experience designed for both watching and listening.

Whether you're studying, listening to music, catching up on your favorite content, or simply relaxing, Tube PiP gives you more flexibility in how you watch and listen.

Download Tube PiP today and enjoy YouTube your way!

show_hn.title: Show HN: Tube PiP – A free YouTube app for iOS with PiP, background play, no ads

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I built an iOS app called Tube PiP because I was frustrated with the official YouTube app locking useful features behind Premium.

Tube PiP gives you:

-  Picture-in-Picture (PiP) playback
-  Background / lock screen playback
-  Sleep timer
-  No ads
-  Hide Shorts (for sanity)

All the stuff you normally have to pay for—free.

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/tube-pip-pip-for-youtube/id6476895094

I’d love to hear what you think. Feedback, bug reports, feature requests—bring it on!
